data.title: 美杜莎 Rider · 单车篮里的鲜面包
data.description: 美杜莎穿米色轻风衣站在街角单车旁，俯身用布带固定车篮里的面包纸袋。很长的紫发被她拢到肩前，确认袋口不会被风吹开后，才抬起眼向前方安静看去。
data.action: 用布带固定车篮里的面包袋，检查绳结后抬眼。
data.promptProse: Medusa ties a cloth strap around the bakery bag in her parked bicycle's front basket, testing the knot before lifting calm violet eyes toward the empty street. Her beige coat covers a black turtleneck and dark trousers; long purple hair is gathered forward clear of the wheels. The medium view includes basket and handlebars along the street perspective. Soft morning light catches the weave and knot, with gentle bag shadows inside the basket.
